gold: IBD-associated neutrophilic dermatosis with ulcerative colitis

selector.rationale: Neutrophilic dermatosis and ulceration with intracorneal neutrophils support Pyoderma gangrenosum

rejected.label: Inflammatory bowel disease
rejected.why: Although the patient has a history of diverticulosis and colonic polyps, and colonoscopy showed moderate inflammation, the primary presentation is dermatological

rejected.label: Erythema nodosum
rejected.why: The presence of well-demarcated vegetative crusted plaques and intradermal neutrophilic inflammation is not typical for Erythema nodosum
